Her hair is light brown rather than blonde, gray, pink or Sakiko's blue. BOTH eyes and their fine linework remain clear and visible; bangs frame the eyes naturally instead of hiding either eye. White linen and uniform whites reflect evening light rather than shining daylight-white; fine blue-gray eyes remain readable. No split half-day/half-night, hard horizontal/vertical boundary, violet overlay, new moon/stars or invented rain.

Retain refined youthful 2D anime linework and naturally modeled shading integrated with the detailed literary-room illustration. No recasting, mature model styling, new body, cropped feet, gray/gold overlay, extra spotlight, halo, neon, UI, captions, readable book text, logo, watermark, collage, borders or artificial foreground fog.
